calibration_sources: OmniDocBench (CVPR 2025/2026): Comprehensive Benchmark for Document Parsing across Text, Tables, Formulas & Charts
MinerU & Docling Technical Reports (Multi-Stage Layout Detection, Reading-Order LayoutReader & HTML Table Reconstruction)
allenai/olmOCR (Document Anchoring with PDF Text Coordinates) & ColPali / ColQwen2 Late-Interaction Visual Patch Retrieval

workload.corpus_profile: 1,000,000 Enterprise PDF Pages (60% Native Multi-Column Text, 25% Complex Merged Financial Tables, 15% Charts/Diagrams/Scanned Equations)
workload.hardware_baseline: NVIDIA L40S / H100 Document Ingestion Cluster ($2.30/GPU-hr effective amortized rate)
workload.evaluation_benchmark: OmniDocBench + Financial Table TEDS (Tree-Edit-Distance-Based Similarity) + Downstream RAG Exact-Number QA

tiers.name: Tier 1: 传统规则流提取 PyMuPDF / pdfplumber + CPU Tesseract OCR
tiers.name_en: Tier 1: Legacy Rule-Based PDF Stream + CPU Tesseract OCR (PyMuPDF / pdfplumber)
tiers.parsing_architecture: Raw PDF character stream extraction + heuristic line merging + CPU Tesseract on raster images
tiers.chart_and_table_handling: Scrambles 2-column reading order; loses merged table cell hierarchy; ignores visual charts
tiers.recommended_for: Plain single-column digital-born TXT/PDFs without tables or charts; strictly unfit for financial reports, engineering manuals, or academic PDFs (45.8% RAG failure rate).

tiers.name: Tier 2: 多阶段版面检测专用小模型流水线 (MinerU / Docling: YOLO + 表格/公式专模)
tiers.name_en: Tier 2: Multi-Stage Layout Specialist Pipeline (MinerU / Docling: DocLayout-YOLO + Table/Formula Models)
tiers.parsing_architecture: DocLayout-YOLO bounding-box detection -> Reading-Order LayoutReader -> RapidOCR + StructEqTable + UniMERNet
tiers.chart_and_table_handling: High precision on structured tables & LaTeX equations, but blind to complex visual trend charts/flowcharts
tiers.recommended_for: High-volume text + table + formula corpora without complex charts or messy scans.

tiers.name: Tier 3: 全量页面一刀切 7B VLM 端到端转写 (纯视觉 VLM 逐页生成 Markdown)
tiers.name_en: Tier 3: Uniform End-to-End 7B VLM Page-to-Markdown on 100% of Pages (Unanchored Vision VLM)
tiers.parsing_architecture: Renders every PDF page to 1280×1280 image (~1,600 vision tokens) -> Autoregressive 7B VLM generates ~1,000 tokens/page
tiers.chart_and_table_handling: Strong visual chart understanding, but 7.7x slower/costlier and suffers 3.8% digit transposition/hallucination on dense tables
tiers.recommended_for: Small batches (<10K pages) of heavily scanned or chart-only decks where compute cost is secondary.

tiers.name: Tier 4: 页面复杂度自适应路由 (MinerU + 锚点校准 OlmOCR/VLM) + ColQwen2 视觉双路索引
tiers.name_en: Tier 4: Page-Complexity Adaptive Router (MinerU + Anchor-Grounded 7B VLM) + ColQwen2 Visual Patch Index
tiers.parsing_architecture: 1ms Page Inspector routes 60% clean pages -> Fast Native/Layout, 25% tables -> MinerU HTML, 15% charts/scans -> OlmOCR Anchored 7B VLM FP8 + ColQwen2 128d INT8 MaxSim
tiers.chart_and_table_handling: Injects raw PDF text coordinates as VLM prompt anchors (0.3% numeric error) + preserves native visual patches for diagram retrieval
tiers.recommended_for: Production enterprise knowledge bases (financial filings, chip datasheets, medical records) demanding 93.8% QA accuracy at $92/1M pages (-90.4% cost vs uniform VLM).
